description:
Somos o grupo TERRA VIVA, jovens visionários de Angola. Criámos a Kubiko Terra, uma app que usa dados reais da NASA para dizer ao agricultor o que plantar, quando plantar e quanto regar. Para toda Angola com SMS para quem não tem internet. Porque se a terra está viva, Angola está viva. 

 A TERRA VIVA nasceu em Angola, onde vimos que o agricultor planta sempre a mesma coisa, porque ninguém lhe diz o que o solo precisa.

A nossa app Kubiko Terra usa dados da NASA.
summary: Terra Viva de Angola is a Portuguese-language decision-support web app that helps farmers and agricultural advisors in Angola choose which crop to plant next. Crop rotation protects soil health, reduces pests and can improve yields, but small farmers rarely have a simple way to plan it. Our tool combines NASA POWER climate data for 8 zones of Angola with a rotation engine that suggests crop sequences suited to each zone. The interface uses large signs, icons and very little text so it can be understood quickly. It is a Progressive Web App (PWA), so it can be installed on a phone and opened from the home screen.
details:
What it does: The user chooses a zone of Angola and the app shows its climate profile built from NASA POWER data. A rotation engine then suggests which crops fit that zone and in what order to plant them.

How it works: Climate data for 8 zones was obtained from the NASA POWER API [CONFIRMA: variables used, e.g. temperature, rainfall, solar radiation] and combined with rotation rules to rank crop options.

Benefits and intended impact: A simple, visual way to plan crop rotation using trustworthy satellite-derived climate data, in Portuguese. Better planning can support soil health and more resilient harvests.

Tools: HTML, CSS and JavaScript hosted on GitHub Pages, built as a PWA.

Creativity: We replaced long text with large signs and icons and added an interactive element so farmers can understand the recommendation at a glance.

Factors considered: Local relevance (Angola), low-literacy and low-bandwidth contexts, mobile-first use, and only using NASA data as the data source.
dataRefs: NASA POWER (Prediction Of Worldwide Energy Resources)
